rows.definition: ContextEpoch is the span during which one initially rendered System Context stays the immutable baseline for a session's provider cache. The gateway holds a bounded per-session store of that baseline, and every turn reconciles against it; the epoch ends, bumping a baseline sequence number, when the session compacts, the session identity moves, or an incompatible transition invalidates the rendering.
rows.distinction: ContextEpoch fixes WHEN a rendered system-context baseline may still be reused; it is not the rendered text itself (the baseline snapshot is its payload) and not the cache lookup itself (the epoch contributes one segment to the prefix-cache identity). It also does not own the cache budget, eviction, or reuse accounting, which remain cache-family concerns. ContextEpochGate is the default-off arming switch that decides whether an epoch exists for a turn at all, and FAK_ABLATE_CONTEXT_EPOCH is that gate's only activation environment variable.
